deadline.value: February 1 priority deadline for Fall admission review and funding
deadline.quote: What is the Application Deadline? | The Chemistry Department admits students on a rolling admission basis. However, applications submitted on or before February 1st will receive priority during the admissions review cycle.

gre_general.value: GRE general and subject scores are not required.
gre_general.quote: GRE general and GRE subject scores are not required for admission to UConn Chemistry's graduate program.

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no Chemistry subject test.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Graduate students are admitted under the advisement of the Graduate Admission Committee and choose an adviser during their first semester.
supervisor.quote: Yes, if this adviser will guarantee your financial support and he/she agrees to admit you directly into his/her research group. Otherwise, all graduate students are admitted under the advisement of the Graduate Admission Committee and are required to choose a major adviser by the end of a students' first semester (for fall admits).

funding.value: All admitted graduate students receive financial support through research/teaching assistantships and tuition waivers.
funding.quote: Yes, if this adviser will guarantee your financial support and he/she agrees to admit you directly into his/her research group. Otherwise, all graduate students are admitted under the advisement of the Graduate Admission Committee and are required to choose a major adviser by the end of a students' first semester (for fall admits).

entry_route.value: Direct admission with transcripts from institution where bachelor's degree was received.
entry_route.quote: Upload transcripts from the educational institution where you received your bachelor's degree and any courses taken beyond regardless of whether a degree was received.
